# proxmox_guest_remote_migrate (Resource)

Migrates a guest to another cluster endpoint through `/nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/remote_migrate`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_remote_migrate" "r" {
  node            = "pve-1"
  vmid            = 300
  target_endpoint = "host=pve-2.example.com,apitoken=PVEAPIToken=root@pam!tf=secret"
  target_storage  = "local"
  target_bridge   = "vmbr0"
  online          = true
  triggers        = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `target_endpoint` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `delete` (Boolean)

- `restart` (Boolean)
- `target_bridge` (String)
- `target_storage` (String)
- `target_vmid` (Number)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
